text:
mira: heads-up — seeing a big spike in prometheus series/cardinality starting ~06:10 UTC after the node OS rollout. Grafana per-gpu panels are exploding and a bunch of alerts fired.

kai: saw that too, lots of duplicate dcgm_* metrics. Did we push a new exporter image? :thinking_face:

mira: nope, not from infra. Kernel/containerd rollout on the nodes changed device enumeration order and it looks like the exporter switched which label it emits (gpu_index -> device_uuid). Prometheus ended up scraping both label sets for a while, so series fanout.

tanvi: ouch. We should normalize at scrape time while we fix the exporter. Quick idea: metric relabel to synthesize a stable label and drop the volatile ones. Example we tested in staging: 

```yaml
metric_relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [device_uuid]
    regex: "(.+)"
    target_label: redwood_gpu_id
    replacement: "$1"
    action: replace
  - source_labels: [gpu_index]
    regex: "(.+)"
    target_label: redwood_gpu_id
    replacement: "gpu-$1"
    action: replace
  - regex: 'gpu_index|device'
    action: labeldrop
```

mira: nice, will prepare a canary prometheus scrape config for the gpunodes job and roll to ~5 nodes.

oleg: also opened a tiny exporter PR to emit `redwood_gpu_uuid` (stable hw UUID) instead of the runtime index. PR: https://github.com/redwood/dcgm-exporter/pull/412 (canary image: ghcr.io/redwood/dcgm-exporter:fix-stable-labels)

stef: for alerting noise — suggest we temporarily silence the per-gpu cardinality alert on the cluster while the canary runs, then re-evaluate thresholds. This is also inflating our alerting SLO violations right now.

mira: agreed. Plan: 1) apply prometheus metric_relabel canary to gpunode scrape job (5 nodes) 2) silence per-gpu cardinality alerts for 30m and annotate incident 3) roll exporter patch as DaemonSet canary 10% -> ramp -> 100% 4) postmortem + SLO update if this repeats.

kai: we'll need to compact/cleanup TSDB eventually if series stick around — but wait until exporter roll completes so we don't delete active series. I can queue a cleanup job in 24h if series haven't been culled.

prometheus-bot: Alert: GPU series-cardinality > 500k (recovered) — silenced by stef for 00:30:00.

mira: assigning follow-ups: @oncall (kai) will do the prometheus canary, @oleg will monitor exporter canary and push the DS roll, @tanvi will draft the alert silence and update runbook. I'll own the postmortem. :thumbsup:

kai: starting prometheus canary now, pushing config to prometheus-canary (will post logs).

oleg: starting daemonset canary with ghcr image, linking rollout here once pod statuses look good.

mira: thanks all — keep updates here. If you see further card spikes tag me.
